```{r Set Time Bin Width}
## We are interested in detections within 3 hours of a high / low tide.
## Set maximum time from the most recent high or low tide. Value is in hours.
## Note that this is either side of the tide, so bin width will be double.
tideTimeCutoff <- 3

# FILTER OUT ANY DETECTIONS FURTHER THAN 3 HOURS FROM HIGH / LOW TIDE
## Note that this prevents analysis of those other detections.
## They will need to be considered separately or the tidal classification
## code / data will have to be re-structured.
df.detections <- df.alltags %>% 
  filter(tideTimeDiff <= tideTimeCutoff)
```

```{r Calculate Detection Duration}
df.detections <- df.detections %>% 
  # Count the number of detections for each combination of unique tidal period,
  # receiver, and tag.
  group_by(motusTagID, recvDeployName, tideID) %>% 
  summarise(detectionCount = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Add variables of interest from original data frame to the summarised result
  left_join(df.alltags %>% 
              select(motusTagID, recvDeployName, tideID, speciesEN, tideCategory, tagBI) %>%
              distinct(), 
            by = c("motusTagID", "recvDeployName", "tideID")) %>%
  # Calculate detection duration by multiplying the number of detections and
  # the burst interval. detectionDuration is in seconds.
  mutate(detectionDuration = detectionCount*tagBI,
         detectionDurationMin = detectionDuration/60) %>%
  mutate(tideCategory = fct_relevel(tideCategory, "Diurnal_Low", "Nocturnal_Low", "Diurnal_High", "Nocturnal_High"))

## Calculate detection duration in seconds
df.detections <- df.detections %>% 
  mutate(detectionDuration = detectionCount*tagBI,
         detectionDurationMin = detectionDuration/60)


## Reorder factor levels for tideCategory to choose order in plot
df.detections <- df.detections %>%
  mutate(tideCategory = fct_relevel(tideCategory, "Diurnal_Low", "Nocturnal_Low", "Diurnal_High", "Nocturnal_High"))


```

```{r Individual Tag - Mean, SE, and Bar Plot}
# Filter data for the specific tag
tag.tmp <- 81121

sum.singletag <- df.detections %>%
  filter(motusTagID == tag.tmp)

sum.singletag <- sum.singletag %>% 
  group_by(recvDeployName, tideCategory) %>% 
  summarise(meanDuration = mean(detectionDuration),
            sd = sd(detectionDuration, na.rm = TRUE),
            periodCount = n(),
            se = sd/sqrt(periodCount)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Create the bar plot with error bars
ggplot(sum.singletag, aes(x = recvDeployName, y = meanDuration, fill = tideCategory)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), colour = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanDuration - se, ymax = meanDuration + se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste(sep =" ", "Mean Detection Duration for Tag",tag.tmp,"(", tag.species(tag.tmp),")"),
    x = "Site",
    y = "Mean Detection Duration (± SE)",
    fill = "Tide Category"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  easy_center_title()

```

```{r Summarise by Species)}
# Select species of interest
tmp.species <- c("Red-necked Avocet", "Pacific Golden-Plover", "Pied Stilt")

# Filter by species of interest
sum.alltags <- df.detections %>% 
  filter(speciesEN %in% tmp.species)
  
# Group by tag, receiver, and tidal category, then
# calculate the mean detection duration, SD, and SE
sum.alltags <- sum.alltags %>%  
  group_by(recvDeployName, tideCategory, motusTagID, speciesEN) %>% 
    summarise(meanDuration = mean(detectionDuration),
              sd = sd(detectionDuration, na.rm = TRUE),
              periodCount = n(),
              se = sd/sqrt(periodCount),
              .groups = "drop") 

# Remove values with very low period count
#sum.alltags <- sum.alltags %>% filter(
#  periodCount >3
#)

# Group by species, receiver, and tidal category, then
# calculate the mean detection duration, ## not sure how to do error ##
sum.species <- sum.alltags %>% 
  group_by(speciesEN,recvDeployName, tideCategory) %>% 
  summarise(meanDurationSpecies = mean(meanDuration),
            sd = sd(meanDuration),
            individualCount = n(),
            se = sd/sqrt(individualCount),
            .groups = "drop")

```

```{r Three-way Repeated Measures ANOVA}
# Get statistical summary
sum.species <- sum.alltags %>% 
  group_by(speciesEN, tideCategory, recvDeployName) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(meanDuration, type = "mean_se")

## Filter out rows with detection during a single period (SE = NA) or 2 periods
sum.anova <- sum.alltags %>% 
  filter(#is.na(se)==FALSE)
    periodCount > 2)

# Check for outliers
outliers <- sum.anova %>% 
  group_by(speciesEN, tideCategory, recvDeployName) %>% 
  identify_outliers(meanDuration)

#### Have not implemented code to remove outliers ####
### After removing the single period rows (NA se), none of the outliers
### are extreme###

# Get summary statistics for each species
summary_stats <- sum.anova %>% 
  group_by(speciesEN, recvDeployName, tideCategory) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(meanDuration, type = "mean_se")

# Filter out combinations of species / category / receiver with n < 3
valid_groups <- sum.anova %>%
  group_by(speciesEN, recvDeployName, tideCategory) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  filter(n >= 3)

# Join valid groups back to the original dataset to filter only valid motusTagID
final_data <- sum.anova %>%
  semi_join(valid_groups, by = c("speciesEN", "recvDeployName", "tideCategory"))

# Check normality assumption
not_normal <- final_data %>% 
  group_by(speciesEN, tideCategory, recvDeployName) %>% 
  shapiro_test(meanDuration) %>% 
  filter(p < 0.05)

## Remove rows that are not normal
# Step 1: Extract the non-normal combinations
non_normal_combinations <- not_normal %>%
  select(speciesEN, tideCategory, recvDeployName)

# Step 2: Filter out non-normal combinations from final_data
cleaned_final_data <- final_data %>%
  anti_join(non_normal_combinations, by = c("speciesEN", "tideCategory", "recvDeployName"))

## To add: qq plot for normality assessment ##

# Coerce grouping variables to factor
cleaned_final_data <- cleaned_final_data %>% 
  mutate(recvDeployName = as.factor(recvDeployName),
         speciesEN = as.factor(speciesEN))

# ANOVA
res.aov <- anova_test(
  data = cleaned_final_data, dv = meanDuration, wid = motusTagID,
  within = c(speciesEN, recvDeployName, tideCategory)
)

```

```{r Chat GPT Test}
# Step 1: Compute the average detection duration per tag for each site × tide category
df.avg_tag <- df.detections %>%
  group_by(motusTagID, recvDeployName, tideCategory) %>%
  summarise(avg_detection_duration = mean(detectionDuration), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Compute the average detection duration per species for each site × tide category
df.avg_species <- df.avg_tag %>%
  left_join(df.detections %>% select(motusTagID, speciesEN) %>% distinct(), by = "motusTagID") %>%
  group_by(speciesEN, recvDeployName, tideCategory) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_species_detection = mean(avg_detection_duration),
    se = sd(avg_detection_duration) / sqrt(n()),  # Standard error for error bars
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Plot the results
ggplot(df.avg_species, aes(x = tideCategory, y = avg_species_detection, fill = speciesEN)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_species_detection - se, ymax = avg_species_detection + se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~recvDeployName) +  # Facet by site
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Detection Duration by Species, Site, and Tide Category",
    x = "Tide Category",
    y = "Average Detection Duration",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
